audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows gave Yone stages the packet chart and every whys line assign to Illaoi: L2 was 'Skill', L3, Levels 4-5 and first item were Yone.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 53.79%. Test of Spirit reaches 900 against a 450-range Mortal Steel, and Yone has no projectile block to protect his soul — his only escape is Soul Unbound, which snaps him back to where he started.
audit.corrected: Illaoi L1 through first item; Yone at 2+ items. diff also moved from EVEN to FAV to match the win rate and the tone colour already set.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Soul Unbound' was repeated everywhere with no cooldown attached, and the level-6 spike ignored what Fate Sealed actually does.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — 22 seconds at rank 1, which is the widest punish window in the lane and shrinks by more than half by rank 5. Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s at 1000 range and 'blinks behind the last champion in a line, pulling all enemies hit towards him' — a lineup punisher, not a duel tool.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the R behaviour written into spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The knock-up was described as 'Q3' and as something that 'comes out slow'; neither is in the data. Spirit Cleave's shield condition was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne' — two stacks, not three, and the tell is the stack count, not the animation speed. Riot's W text: the shield 'is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe', so in a sidelane 1v1 it is at its weakest.
audit.corrected: Both written into spikes[0] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern', and breakdown.late said anti-heal stays core.
audit.why: Yone has no healing in his kit — passive, Q, W, E and R carry none. W is a shield. Grievous Wounds is wasted gold here.
audit.corrected: report[8] and breakdown.late corrected to armour.

audit.why: The packet reports no defects and no suspect names for this matchup; all ability names on the page check out against the kit.

edits.before: Yone has no Windwall to protect his soul, so E Test of Spirit lands cleanly whenever he steps to CS. W Harsh Lesson lets you dash and re-slam with Q the instant he Q2-dashes at you; his knockup comes out slow, and you can pre-slam tentacles so his approach eats them.
edits.after: Yone has no Wind Wall to protect his soul, so Test of Spirit lands from 900 whenever he steps to CS — Mortal Steel only reaches 450. The knock-up exists only at two Gathering Storm stacks, so count his Qs: one stack is safe, two means the dash is coming. Pre-slam that spot.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith drops a tentacle ring right as he tries his own R Fate Sealed dash-through. He can Q3 knockup you, but every surrounding tentacle beats on him and his spirit-form E only delays the reckoning, sending him back to a worse position.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle per champion hit, 450 range, 120s at rank 1 — the same 120s as Fate Sealed. His R blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward him, so never line up with your team. Soul Unbound only delays: it snaps him back.

edits.before: Bruiser stats plus wall-fed passive tentacles make extended trades lopsided; his Q pokes and E double-dash burst can't out-DPS your slam stacks. Shove waves and zone him off the tentacles.
edits.after: Bruiser stats plus wall-fed tentacles make extended trades lopsided. Spirit Cleave (W) scales its shield with the number of champions hit — in a sidelane 1v1 that is its weakest. Shove and zone him off CS.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are all Illaoi: W sticks to his dashes, E rips his spirit off any greedy CS, and R at 6 traps him in slams he can only delay with his E rewind, not escape.
edits.after: Levels 2-6 are all Illaoi: Harsh Lesson sticks on a 4s cooldown, Test of Spirit rips his soul from 900, and Soul Unbound is down 22s at rank 1 — his snap-back is where your E should already be aimed.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Yone has no healing in his kit — skip anti-heal here.

edits.before: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button — build your teamfight around that. Yone carry threat: 9/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button — build your teamfight around that. Yone carry threat: 9/10 — armour stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Soul Unbound and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Soul Unbound and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Yone carry threat 9/10.
edits.after: Favoured lane — difficulty 5/10, Yone carry threat 9/10.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours until two items — that is the one swing point. See the chart below.

notes: Same wasted-gold error as the yasuo page: Executioner's Calling prescribed against a champion with no healing in his kit. Also corrected 'Q3 knockup' — Mortal Steel goes Airborne at two Gathering Storm stacks, and the stack count is the tell rather than the cast animation. Chart disagreed with the packet on four of seven rows; repaired in matched pairs, and diff moved EVEN to FAV to match a 53.79% win rate.
